assessment: Alpha.504 fixes a genuine missing-self-bake selection gap: previously accepted Low158 suppressed ALL authenticated self ObjectUpdate face IDs even for missing Head, Upper and Lower slots. Per-face selection now preserves each existing authoritative Low158 slot and supplements only absent ones from the current self ObjectUpdate scoped by agent, session, region and local ID. The actual renderer uses selected IDs, and F3 labels the explicitly provisional source with separate current GPU evidence, never asserting COF or worn skin completion. Native tests cover conflicting head UUIDs, gaps, local ID invalidation and session changes. Authenticated live NexVerse skin, outfit/COF, attachments and WASD end-to-end still open/unverified. Weighted 38.65 percent, rounded 39 percent.
